name: Bronco Invitational
where: Sunnyvale, CA · host Santa Clara · Baylands Park
headline: Bronco Invitational
summary: Final: Men: D-II No. 8 Chico State won with 45 points, ahead of Santa Clara (78), Nevada (84) and Pepperdine (115), and Emmanuel Leblond won the 8K in 23:24.0 running unattached. Women: D-II No. 4 Chico State won with 46 over Stanislaus State (77), San Francisco (95) and Santa Clara (122), and Santa Clara's Milaina Almonte won the 6K in 20:00.3; No. 20 Stanford's women placed 16th (437).
